seo.title: Vulnerability disclosure policy | Avesta Tech
seo.description: How to report a security vulnerability in Avesta Proof or this website, what we promise in return, and what good-faith research must not do.

sections.heading: Vulnerability disclosure policy
sections.sub: We practise what we sell. If you find a security issue, please tell us.

sections.heading: How to report
paragraphs: Email [SECURITY_EMAIL] with a description of the issue, the steps to reproduce it and the impact you expect. Our contact details are also in [/.well-known/security.txt](/.well-known/security.txt).

sections.heading: What we promise
paragraphs: We acknowledge your report within [RESPONSE_DAYS] working days and keep you informed until it is fixed.
We take no legal action against good-faith research that follows this policy.
We credit researchers who want credit.

sections.heading: What not to do
paragraphs: Do not destroy, change or download data that is not yours.
Do not use social engineering, phishing or physical attacks.
